parts:
Hi,

I am attempting to conduct a sequential mediation analysis using SEM. I have four IVs, Mediator 1, Mediator 2 and then Outcome 1 and Outcome 2 variables. Below is the code I am trying to run in R for only Outcome 1. Can anybody please look at it and let me know, if this is correct. Also, I am not sure how to conduct the same analysis if you have two outcome variables. How can I incorporate second outcome in this model?

Model<-'IV1=~a1+a2+a3+a4+a5

IV2=~b1+b2+b3+b4+b5+b6

IV3=~c1+c2+c3+c4+c5

IV4=~d1+d2+d3+d4+d5+d6

M1=~e1+e2+e3+e4+e5

M2=~f1+f2+f3+f4+f5

O1=~g1+g2+g3+g4+g5

O2=~h1+h2+h3+h4+h5

 

#Measuring direct effects between mediator 1 and IVs

M1 ~ a*IV1

M1 ~ b*IV2

M1 ~ c*IV3

M1 ~ d*IV4

#Measuring direct effects b/w Mediator 2 and IVs

M2 ~ f*IV1

M2 ~ g*IV2

M3 ~ h*IV3

M4 ~ i*IV4

#Measuring effect between mediator1 and mediator 2

M2 ~ e*M1

#Measuring effect between mediator 1 and outcome O1

O1~j*M1

#Measuring effect between mediator 2 and outcome O1

O1~ k*M1

#Measuring direct effect between IVs and outcome O1

O1~l*IV1

O1~m*IV2

O1~n*IV3

O1~o*IV4

#Measuring indirect effects for IV1

IE1 := a*e*k

IE2 := a*j

IE3 := f*k

IETotal := IE1+IE2+IE3

#Direct Effect

DE := IETotal + l

#Measuring indirect effects for IV2

WIE1 := b*e*k

WIE2 := b*j

WIE3 := g*k

WIETotal := WIE1+WIE2+WIE33

#Direct Effect

WDE := WIETotal + m

#Measuring indirect effects for IV3

SIE1 := c*e*k

SIE2 := c*j

SIE3 := h*k

SIETotal := SIE1+SIE2+SIE3

#Direct Effect

SDE := SIETotal + n

#Measuring indirect effects for IV4

KIE1 := d*e*k

fitModel<-sem(Model, data=ad_data,se="bootstrap", bootstrap=1000)

summary(fitModel,fit.measures=TRUE,standardized=TRUE,rsquare=TRUE)

parameterEstimates(fitModel,ci=TRUE,level=0.95,boot.ci.type='perc')

semPaths(Model,what="paths",whatLabels="par")
